title: RONIN high-knowledge-density source adapters

policy.note: The eight Common Corpus adapters remain enabled for limited candidate extraction. The biology/medicine and chemistry PMC Cloud adapters are also enabled for limited candidate extraction under their exact per-version CC0/CC BY authorization. No adapter is training-admitted; source presence or candidate generation never bypasses global G-0 or human review.

metric.note: RONIN-HKD is an initial deterministic heuristic, not a reproduced implementation of HKS or DSIR. Calibrate against human-ranked samples and downstream ablations.
